A very long, long time ago, I traveled with my X-girlfriend to the Caribbean and one thing I remember with crystal clarity is that a bunch of dudes wolf whistled at my X as she walked by! I supposed they construed her as a looker?

Decades later, after having kids and no longer giving a F about attracting a mate, I was taking a picture of some leucophyllas and out loud, I wolf whistled to the plant, LOL I thought to myself, "dang, fool, this is definitely a looker!"

There might be 2 clones from this batch that look just like this clone in the picture below, so for now, this one is looker#1! I mean, dang this thing is HAWT! Pics taken 9/27/21:
